user.title: Tinxy Local Setup
user.description: Choose how you want to configure your Tinxy devices. All device control operates 100% locally on your home network.

menu_option_descriptions.cloud: Retrieve your device list and encryption keys using an ephemeral API token. The token is immediately discarded after setup.
menu_option_descriptions.manual: Configure directly using the local IP address and private device key (100% offline, no cloud account needed).

cloud.title: Tinxy Cloud Login
cloud.description: Enter your Tinxy Cloud API token to retrieve your devices and local encryption keys. The API token is used once in memory and is **immediately discarded** upon saving.

data_description.api_key: Personal API token generated from the Tinxy Web Portal (Profile -> API Token).

select_cloud_device.title: Configure Tinxy Device
select_cloud_device.description: Select your Tinxy device and verify its local network IP address.

data_description.device_id: Select the Tinxy switch, fan, or lock to configure.
data_description.host: Local network IP address of the device on your Wi-Fi network (auto-detected).

manual.title: Manual Offline Setup
manual.description: Configure your Tinxy device directly using its local network IP address and private device key.

data_description.name: Friendly name for this device (e.g., Living Room Switch).
data_description.host: Local static or DHCP reserved IP address on your Wi-Fi network.
data_description.mqtt_pass: The private encryption key assigned to the device (mqttPassword).
data_description.device_type: Hardware form factor of the device.
data_description.relay_count: Number of relay channels for smart switch modules (1 to 8).

error.cannot_connect_local: Could not connect to device on local network. Ensure IP is correct and device is powered on.
error.no_devices: No devices found on this Tinxy account.

init.title: Tinxy Local Options
init.description: Configure device connection settings and polling frequency for **{name}**.

data_description.host: IP address of the Tinxy device on your local network.
data_description.mqtt_pass: The private encryption password assigned to the device.
data_description.request_timeout: Maximum seconds to wait for a local HTTP response (default: 5s).
data_description.polling_interval: Seconds between state updates from the device (default: 5s).
